name: Chore wheel (fair random assignment)
use_when: tasks get handed out to people at random but fairly: chore wheel, who does what
'make a chore wheel', 'spin for chores', 'randomly assign'
the tasks were named in the chat
tasks go to whoever is in the chat now, including people who join later
dont_use_when: people choose their own tasks (use claims)
picking one option, not assigning a list (use wheel)
guarantees: each spin gives the first open task to someone in the chat with the fewest tasks
picks come from the server seed, the same for everyone, and show only once confirmed
the newest spin always holds its task; spins are 3 s apart
the wheel is the people in the chat now: a late joiner is on it, a leaver's tasks open up again
with no tasks there is no wheel: a short card asks the chat to add them, and anyone can add more later

tasks.description: Tasks named in the chat, up to 12, short. Use [] when the chat names none: never invent tasks; the card then asks the group to add them
